name: plainview
description: A lightweight, ad-free image viewer for Windows

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/contextMenuGeometry.test.ts tests/clipboardCopy.test.ts tests/imageCache.test.ts tests/imageFormats.test.ts tests/updateCheck.test.ts tests/imageCanvas.test.ts tests/windowGeometry.test.ts tests/zoom.test.ts tests/viewState.test.ts tests/asyncIntent.test.ts tests/nativeDialogGuard.test.ts tests/serializedTaskQueue.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: vitest run tests/ContextMenu.test.tsx tests/EmptyContextMenu.test.tsx tests/AboutModal.test.tsx tests/WindowResizeHandles.test.tsx tests/useKeyboardShortcuts.test.tsx tests/useOverlayVisibility.test.ts tests/SettingsModal.test.tsx tests/ErrorView.test.tsx tests/EmptyView.test.tsx tests/OverlayControls.test.tsx tests/useFolderSync.test.tsx tests/modalKeyboard.test.ts
scripts.test:context-menu-ui: vitest run tests/ContextMenu.test.tsx tests/EmptyContextMenu.test.tsx tests/AboutModal.test.tsx tests/WindowResizeHandles.test.tsx tests/useKeyboardShortcuts.test.tsx tests/useOverlayVisibility.test.ts tests/SettingsModal.test.tsx tests/ErrorView.test.tsx tests/EmptyView.test.tsx tests/OverlayControls.test.tsx tests/useFolderSync.test.tsx tests/modalKeyboard.test.ts
scripts.release:windows: npm run tauri build && npm run build:portable
